basic_info.description: 1020 1/2 Alabama is a charming top-floor TIC located in the vibrant Inner Mission neighborhood. This light-filled unit features: 3 Bedrooms/2 Bath  Well-appointed interiors, a fabulous deck for outdoor enjoyment and access to a shared yard.  This property combines flexibility and comfort in one of the city's most sought-after locations. Perfect for those seeking space, light, and community in the heart of San Francisco.
